We are seeking candidates for a PhD position in Data Management and AI on the topic:

“Provenance and Reproducibility in Agentic AI Workflows.”

The PhD will investigate how provenance models can support reproducibility in workflows that integrate AI agents and automated decision processes.

Location: Université Paris-Dauphine – PSL, LAMSADE (Paris, France) Supervisor: Khalid Belhajjame, Professor Contact:

Keywords: workflows, AI, provenance, reproducibility.

Funding: This PhD topic is prioritized for a French Ministry doctoral fellowship.

Application:
Interested candidates should send the following documents:

•

CV

•

Cover letter

•

Academic transcripts (Licence + Master, including rankings when available; partial M2 transcript if applicable)

Applications should be sent as soon as possible and no later than April 9, 2026. A second selection stage will take place through an interview with the doctoral school and the laboratory in May 2026.

Please feel free to share this call with interested students.
